assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a priority set (not 'Undefined'), the plan documents that the Feature's priority is inherited by created tasks — evidenced by priority field values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When the Feature's priority is 'Undefined', the plan documents that priority inheritance is skipped (not propagated as null or 'Undefined')
assertion_results.evidence: Feature TC-9003 has Priority: Critical. The impact-map.md contains an 'Inherited Field Values' section with '| Priority | Critical |' and states 'All tasks created for TC-9003 inherit these values unless explicitly overridden.' The summary-comment.md states '| Priority | Critical | All 9 child tasks (Tasks 1-9) |' with explanation: 'Priority: Critical — inherited from TC-9003. All implementation, bookend, and documentation tasks carry this priority to reflect the feature's urgency.'

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a non-empty fixVersions array and the fixVersion scope config (from ### Jira Field Defaults in CLAUDE.md) is 'task' or 'both' (or absent, defaulting to 'both'), the plan documents that fixVersions are inherited by created tasks — evidenced by fixVersion values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When fixVersion scope is 'feature' or the Feature has no fixVersions, the plan documents that fixVersion inheritance is skipped
assertion_results.evidence: Feature TC-9003 has Fix Versions: RHTPA 1.5.0 (non-empty). CLAUDE.md has no '### Jira Field Defaults' section, so fixVersion scope defaults to 'both'. The impact-map.md contains '| Fix Versions | RHTPA 1.5.0 |' in the Inherited Field Values table. The summary-comment.md states '| Fix Versions | RHTPA 1.5.0 | All 9 child tasks (Tasks 1-9) |' with explanation: 'Fix Versions: RHTPA 1.5.0 — inherited from TC-9003. Ensures all tasks are tracked against the same release milestone, enabling accurate release scope reporting across both repositories.'

assertion_results.text: A summary of inherited field propagation is produced — evidenced by a summary-comment.md file in the outputs directory, or a summary section in the impact map that includes the inherited priority and fixVersion values propagated to tasks, or states they were omitted and why
assertion_results.evidence: summary-comment.md exists in the outputs directory with title 'Inherited Field Propagation — TC-9003'. It contains a table with Priority (Critical) and Fix Versions (RHTPA 1.5.0) propagated to 'All 9 child tasks (Tasks 1-9)' and a 'Propagation Details' section explaining both. Additionally, impact-map.md has an 'Inherited Field Values' section documenting both fields.
